topic: How to prepare a simple vegetable stir-fry
pipeline_error: Groq API returned HTTP error status 400.
script_text: Heat a wok over high flame, add a splash of oil until it shimmers, then toss sliced carrots, bell peppers, broccoli florets, and snap peas, stirring rapidly. Sprinkle a pinch of salt, drizzle soy sauce, and cook until vegetables are crisp‑tender, releasing fragrant steam.
